title: SapNudge
description: What a SAP sender puts on its system's ingest queue to say a pack's exception happened: keys, never data. The consumer re-reads the pack's own OData query narrowed to these keys, so a key that is not an exception in SAP makes nothing. Checked by hand in pipeline/sap_ingest.py (`parse`); a drift test keeps the two agreeing. No twin is generated. At most 16 KB. A breaking change is a version 2 beside this one, never an edit of it.

version.description: Absent means 1. Any other value is refused.

pack_id.description: A published pack whose `source.push` accepts nudges and whose SAP system is the queue's.

system.description: Optional, and only checked: it must be the system whose queue the message came through. The queue, not this field, decides the system.

keys.description: Absent means: poll this pack now. Each item names exactly the pack's key fields that sit on the entity it queries (`source.key[].field`, parent-scoped; for finance_ops `SupplierInvoice` and `FiscalYear`), with values as SAP holds them, unstripped.
